ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisite: ADV 300 and a specified course in statistical methods. Prerequisites will be enforced. This course open only to all sophomores, juniors and seniors in the College of Media and Agricultural Communications.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Advertising or News-Editorial or Broadcast Journalism or Media Studies or General Curriculum major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
